column1: # Generated data left out of the PR size cap (scripts/pr_cap_prod.py prints it as GENERATED_DATA).
# A file here is produced by a tool and checked by a command, so it is not review surface.
# One row per glob, three tab-separated fields: glob<TAB>generation command<TAB>verification command
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. The list is read from the measured head commit.

column2: cargo check -p agentdesk --lib --features test-support --message-format short --color never on the codemod output (each error names a missing gated item; a person confirms each bundle, one entry per line)
column3: python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("scripts/crate_split/test_support_bundles.json"))' && python3 scripts/crate_split/test_support_codemod.py --count && python3 scripts/crate_split/test_support_verify.py <tool commit> <conversion commit> --compile agentdesk
